scope: Installer/lifecycle and non-graphical native ELF/library prerequisites only. User-confirmed working guide setup is a reference, not new packaged gameplay evidence.

packages.limits: Complete supplied upscale, voxel and SC-55 archives; guide-defined arguments, game-local state, source preservation and exact isolated lifecycle checks. Guide engine bytes are reused read-only. Source build preparation is separately approved; a newly compiled unknown hash remains gated before game writes. ELF/library prerequisites do not certify engine invocation, OpenGL, input, sound, real GRP gameplay or save/relaunch. Confirm these before relying on the installation.
